name: ways-of-working
description: Ways-of-working skills that compute from files you already have: a CAB-style change record from a Terraform plan JSON or PR export with needs-reviewer flags, one action ledger across meeting notes with overdue, ownerless and carried items, a security exception register lint with a review agenda, an RFC writer with a lifecycle lint, and a one-file-per-decision log with review dates and supersede links. Standard-library scripts, no network, no rating of people.
